arxiv-2112-14579.title: S -wave pion-pion scattering lengths from nucleon-meson fluctuations
arxiv-2112-14579.creator: Jürgen Eser, Jean-Paul Blaizot
arxiv-2112-14579.description: Abstract We present calculations of the S S -wave isospin-zero and isospin-two pion-pion scattering lengths within a nucleon-meson model with parity doubling. Both scattering lengths are computed in various approximations, ranging from a mean-field (MF) calculation towards the inclusion of loop corrections by means of the functional renormalization group (FRG).

arxiv-2204-04451.title: An Axially Symmetric Transitioning models with Observational Constraints
arxiv-2204-04451.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . In this study, we have demonstrated the expansion history of an axially symmetric Bianchi type-I model of the universe. Our model as of now presents an accelerating universe, which had been in the decelerating phase in the past. Roles of the two crucial Hubble H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) and deceleration q ⁡ ( z ) q(z) parameters are examined.

arxiv-2312-09948.title: GEAR-Up: Generative AI and External Knowledge-based Retrieval Upgrading Scholarly Article Searches for Systematic Reviews
arxiv-2312-09948.creator: Kaushik Roy, Vedant Khandelwal, Harshul Surana, Valerie Vera, Amit Sheth, Heather Heckman
arxiv-2312-09948.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kaushik Roy, Vedant Khandelwal, Harshul Surana, Valerie Vera, Amit Sheth, Heather Heckman. Systematic reviews (SRs) - the librarian-assisted literature survey of scholarly articles takes time and requires significant human resources. Given the ever-increasing volume of published studies, applying existing computing and informatics technology can decrease this time and resource burden.

arxiv-2403-10950.title: Coalescence of non-spherical drops with a liquid surface Journal: International Journal of Multiphase Flow
arxiv-2403-10950.creator: Nagula Venkata Anirudh a , Sachidananda Behera a and Kirti Chandra Sahu b
arxiv-2403-10950.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nagula Venkata Anirudh a , Sachidananda Behera a and Kirti Chandra Sahu b. We employ three-dimensional numerical simulations to explore the impact dynamics of non-spherical drops in a deep liquid pool by varying the aspect ratios ( A r ) (A_{r}) and Weber numbers ( 𝑊𝑒 ) ({\it We}) . We observe that when a non-spherical drop is gently placed on a liquid pool, it exhibits a partial coalescence phenomenon and the emergence of a daughter droplet for A r > 0.67 A_{r}>0.67 .

arxiv-2405-08236.title: Existence of attracting invariant 2 2 -curves in fibred quadratic dynamics
arxiv-2405-08236.creator: Igsyl Domínguez
arxiv-2405-08236.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Igsyl Domínguez. We present a construction of new invariant sets for fibred polynomial dynamics with base an irrational rotation over the unit circle, called multi-curves . Furthermore, the local dynamical theory for attracting invariant curves is extended to these objects. 1 Introduction In a given dynamical system, it is possible to find several types of invariant objects, such as fixed and periodic points, a minimal complex attractor, and the support of an invariant measure, among others.

pmc-10529811.title: Real-World Evidence on the Prevalence of Molar Incisor Hypomineralization in School Children from Bucharest, Romania
pmc-10529811.creator: Beatrice Ciocan, Mihai Săndulescu, Rodica Luca, Evgenija Marković, Tamara O Perić
pmc-10529811.description: Molar incisor hypomineralization (MIH) is an understudied and underrecognized clinical entity occurring in children. We performed a cross-sectional study to determine the real-world prevalence of MIH among school children undergoing routine dental checkups at one primary and middle school in Bucharest, Romania. Our study cohort consisted of 266 children with evaluable data, of which 143 (53.

pmc-10557249.title: Using the canadian egg ladder in children with food protein-induced enterocolitis syndrome: a case series
pmc-10557249.creator: Linlei Ye, Tiffany Wong, Elana Lavine, Victoria E Cook, Stephanie C Erdle
pmc-10557249.description: BackgroundCurrent management of food protein-induced enterocolitis syndrome (FPIES) involves strict avoidance of the offending food for 12–18 months, followed by oral food challenge (OFC) under physician supervision. OFCs are resource-intensive and there is a lack of a universal standardized protocol for FPIES. Prolonged avoidance may increase the risk of IgE-mediated allergy, particularly in atopic patients.

pmc-10704698.title: Feasibility and acceptability of the use of flash glucose monitoring encountered by Indigenous Australians with type 2 diabetes mellitus: initial experiences from a pilot study
pmc-10704698.creator: Audrey Sing Yi Eer, Rebecca Chia Yee Ho, Tracey Hearn, Mariam Hachem, Megan Freund, Luke James Burchill, Sharon Atkinson-Briggs, Satpal Singh, Sandra Eades, Richard Charles O’Brien, John Stuart Furler, David Norman O’Neal, David Andrew Story, Jeffrey David Zajac, Sabine Braat, Alex Brown, Phillip Cl
pmc-10704698.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is highly prevalent within the Indigenous Australian community. Novel glucose monitoring technology offers an accurate approach to glycaemic management, providing real-time information on glucose levels and trends. The acceptability and feasibilility of this technology in Indigenous Australians with T2DM has not been investigated.

pmc-11359051.title: The Quest for the Holy Grail Of 3D Printing: A Critical Review of Recycling in Polymer Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing
pmc-11359051.creator: Bruno Alexandre de Sousa Alves, Dimitrios Kontziampasis, Abdel-Hamid Soliman, Luigi Sorrentino
pmc-11359051.description: The benefits of additive manufacturing (AM) are widely recognised, boosting the AM method’s use in industry, while it is predicted AM will dominate the global manufacturing industry. Alas, 3D printing’s growth is hindered by its sustainability. AM methods generate vast amounts of residuals considered as waste, which are disposed of.

pmc-12438764.title: Assessment of Functionality, Global Clinical Impression, and Addiction Severity in Patients with Dual Diagnosis Treated with Long-Acting Injectable Antipsychotics in a Specialized Center in Bogotá-Colombia
pmc-12438764.creator: J. Gonzalez Giraldo, A. Cruz
pmc-12438764.description: IntroductionDual diagnosis, involving both a mental disorder and an addiction disorder, significantly impacts patients’ functionality and quality of life. In Colombia, from 2009 to 2017, an average of 20,590 individuals with dual diagnosis were treated annually, representing 7.2 Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) (Ministerio de Salud, Boletín de Salud Mental No. 7, 2018).

pmc-12645649.title: Mixed-methods psychosocial autopsy study of suicide in young and middle-aged individuals in the Netherlands
pmc-12645649.creator: Elias Balt, Saskia Mérelle, Stefan Vrinzen, Merijn Eikelenboom, Amra Žerić, Dewi Wiggers, Renske Gilissen, Daan Creemers, Arne Popma
pmc-12645649.description: IntroductionSociodemographic characteristics of suicide decedents are recorded in the Netherlands, through which we know who died by suicide, but not why. In this mixed-methods, informant-based psychosocial autopsy, we aimed to identify psychosocial characteristics and precipitating factors of suicide in young (aged 10–30) and middle-aged (40–70 years old) women and men and investigate differences on a group level.

pmc-12734736.title: Gallium Liquid Metal Microdroplets for Constructing Active Therapeutic Agents in Photothermal Therapy of Ulcerative Colitis
pmc-12734736.creator: Zesheng Li, Yuzhu Di, Lubo Jin, Bo Qu, Hongyue Zhang, Nam-Trung Nguyen, Jianguo Guan, Ming Luo
pmc-12734736.description: Gallium-based liquid metals have been extensively studied in the field of biomedical engineering, including applications in tumor and inflammatory disease therapy, as well as targeted drug delivery. Among these, leveraging the photothermal effect of gallium liquid metals enables effective treatment of heat-sensitive cells in tumor regions and enhances the diffusion capability of liquid metal microdroplets.

pmc-13066555.title: Bayesian machine learning enables discovery of risk factors for hepatosplenic multimorbidity related to schistosomiasis
pmc-13066555.creator: Yin-Cong Zhi, Victor Anguajibi, John B Oryema, Betty Nabatte, Christopher K Opio, Narcis B Kabatereine, Goylette F Chami
pmc-13066555.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). One in 25 deaths worldwide is related to liver disease, and often with multiple hepatosplenic conditions. Yet, little is understood of the risk factors for hepatosplenic multimorbidity, especially in the context of chronic infections. We present a novel Bayesian multitask learning framework to jointly model 45 hepatosplenic conditions assessed using point-of-care B-mode ultrasound for 3155 individuals aged 5-91 years within the SchistoTrack cohort across rural Uganda, where chronic intestinal schistosomiasis is endemic.

pmc-13207174.title: Does Aging Affect PolyJet™ 3D-Printed Teeth for Endodontics? A Micro-CT Evaluation
pmc-13207174.creator: Cláudia Barbosa, Tiago Reis, José B. Reis, Margarida Franco, Catarina Batista, Rui B. Ruben, Benjamín Martín-Biedma, José Martín-Cruces
pmc-13207174.description: This study aimed to evaluate the aging effect (6 and 12 months), relative to baseline (0 months), on the dimensional accuracy, morphological stability, and shaping behavior of PolyJet™ 3D-printed teeth (3DPT) produced in two printing orientations (X and Y axes).

pmc-13305676.title: Predicted Functional Potentials of Bacterial Communities in Fermented Maize Products From Ghana, Nigeria, and Benin via 16S rRNA Amplicon Sequencing and PICRUSt2
pmc-13305676.creator: Humphrey P. K. Addy, David Amedorme, Priscilla Osei‐Poku, Alexander Kwarteng
pmc-13305676.description: Fermented maize products are integral to the diets of many African communities. Despite their cultural significance and health benefits, little is known about the metabolic potential of their microbial populations. This study utilized 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing data from the NCBI to characterize the functional capabilities of microbiomes in six maize‐based fermented foods.

pmc-13388851.title: On stage: the association between self-efficacy, flow, anxiety, and performers’ well-being in musical performance
pmc-13388851.creator: Qihuan Chen, Yannan Liu, Xiaojing Sun, Li Pan
pmc-13388851.description: IntroductionIn Chinese higher music education, performance-based assessments constitute a central component of students’ academic experience, and psychological factors are closely associated with performance outcomes. Although self-efficacy, flow, and anxiety have been widely discussed in music-related research, few studies have examined these variables together in relation to music performance well-being.

pmc-13526884.title: Serum Aβ42 and hemoglobin as independent predictors of post-stroke cognitive impairment: a comparative biomarker study
pmc-13526884.creator: Talha Bin Sajjad, Aamna Zahid, Huzaifa Rehman, Sundus Nadeem, Muhammad Aetesam Nasir, Shaista Rauf, Muhammad Waqar Mazhar, Ahmad Raza, Inibehe Ime Okon
pmc-13526884.description: Stroke is a devastating medical condition, and one of its side effects is post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI). The objective of this study is to investigate and analyse the potential indicators for post-stroke cognitive decline (PSCI), with a particular emphasis on the biomarkers Aβ42 (beta-amyloid 42) and haemoglobin (Hb) levels.

pmc-13688760.title: Effectiveness of mHealth interventions on glycemic outcomes in adults with type 2 diabetes in Gulf countries: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13688760.creator: Yousif B. Hamadalneel, Tanzeel M. A. Omer, Toga K. Mohamed, Mai Elzain Omer, Abdulmoniem Elmansor, Muataz Khalil, Hifa O. Ahmed
pmc-13688760.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) poses a major public health challenge in Gulf countries and has among the highest global prevalence; although mobile health (mHealth) interventions have demonstrated global benefits for diabetes self-management, region-specific evidence remains limited.ObjectiveTo assess the effectiveness of mHealth interventions compared with usual care for glycemic control among adults with T2DM in Gulf countries.
